media:group.media:title: Muse from Meta Can Work Through Your To-Do List
media:group.media:description:
Try these four tasks with Muse from Meta.
You can text Muse like a friend and ask it to do real work for you. Make a personalized birthday card, plan meals around your budget and what’s in your fridge, build a grocery list, or ask Muse to negotiate a refund on your behalf.
You can also have Muse manage your to-do list and work through tasks while you’re busy. You control what Muse can access and which actions it can take.
